saw_lines: Nobody buys a face cream because it is new. They buy the one that fixed their skin problem, then reorder it.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides if this cream fixes their problem.
Your 11 of 15 copy ads open on one line. Test three new openers, starting with the zinc and hyaluronic base of The Glow.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: 11 of 15 copy ads open on one line, so a repeat viewer gets no new reason to buy. Test three new openers: the zinc and hyaluronic base of The Glow, a calm evening routine, and a first week customer quote.
Your site has a shipping page, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers must leave the ad to check. Open three new ads with one line on how and when orders ship.
One exact copy runs in 11 of 15 ads, so a buyer who sees two of them reads the same words twice. Keep the body text, but give each ad its own opening line and a new frame or carousel.

None of your 28 ads shows a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and put it on the creative in your next batch.
